app_documentation:
The Hospital Appointment Booking System is a comprehensive mobile-first healthcare platform designed to streamline the appointment scheduling process between patients and medical practitioners. Built using modern web technologies including React for the frontend, Node.js with Express for the backend, and PostgreSQL for data persistence, the system provides a secure, user-friendly interface accessible on both web and mobile platforms (iOS and Android). The application employs JWT-based authentication to ensure secure access control across three distinct user roles: Patients, Doctors, and Administrators.

The primary purpose of this system is to eliminate the traditional barriers and inefficiencies associated with hospital appointment booking by providing patients with real-time visibility into doctor availability, instant booking confirmation, and automated appointment reminders. Patients can create and manage their profiles including personal and medical information, search for doctors by specialization, view available time slots, and book appointments with their chosen healthcare providers. The system features intelligent conflict prevention to avoid double-booking and sends automated notifications 24 hours before scheduled appointments to reduce no-shows.

Key features include comprehensive patient registration with medical history tracking, advanced doctor search with filtering by specialization and availability, interactive appointment scheduling with visual time slot selection, flexible appointment management allowing cancellation and rescheduling, and a robust notification system for reminders and booking confirmations. Doctors can set their recurring weekly availability schedules, view their appointment calendars with patient details, and receive instant notifications of new bookings. The system maintains a complete audit trail of all appointments with status tracking (scheduled, completed, cancelled, rescheduled) and supports multiple time zones for accurate scheduling.

The intended users span three primary groups: Patients seeking convenient access to healthcare services and appointment management, Medical Doctors requiring efficient schedule management and patient appointment visibility, and Hospital Administrators needing oversight capabilities for user and appointment management across the system. The mobile-first design prioritizes accessibility with WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, ensuring the platform is usable by individuals of all ages and abilities. The clean medical aesthetic with calming colors, clear visual hierarchy, and intuitive touch-friendly components creates a patient-centric experience that reduces the stress often associated with healthcare interactions.

glossary.Appointment Slot: A specific time period (default 30 minutes) during which a doctor is available to see a patient. Slots are defined by the doctor's schedule and can be in one of several states: available, booked, or blocked.
glossary.JWT (JSON Web Token): A secure authentication mechanism used to verify user identity and maintain session state. The system issues JWT tokens upon successful login, which must be included in subsequent API requests to access protected resources.
glossary.Doctor Schedule: A recurring weekly availability pattern set by doctors indicating their working hours. Schedules are defined by day of week, start time, and end time, and determine when patients can book appointments.
glossary.Notification Type: Categories of automated system messages sent to users, including appointment reminders (sent 24 hours before scheduled time), booking confirmations (sent immediately upon successful booking), cancellation notices (sent when appointments are cancelled), and rescheduling alerts (sent when appointment times are changed).
glossary.User Role: The access level and permissions assigned to each system user. The three roles are: Patient (can book and manage their own appointments), Doctor (can set availability and view their appointment schedule), and Administrator (can manage all users and appointments across the system).
glossary.Appointment Status: The current state of a scheduled appointment, which can be: scheduled (confirmed and upcoming), completed (patient visit finished), cancelled (appointment removed by patient or doctor), or rescheduled (moved to a different time slot).
